lines: Anyway, everything was futile if I had no clue what was going on.
I brought Asuka with me, as she seemed to know something, and snuck out of class.
Ahem, let's see... Where should I start...?
In the empty hallway of the practical training building, Asuka was tilting her head like she was at a loss.
What the heck, you show up and deliver such a suggestive line, it turns out you don't actually know anything?
That's not it! It's just that... things are a little complicated, so it's hard to explain.
Complicated...? Well, that's for sure, what with all the puzzling feelings from having these other memories in my head...
Yes, that's itーdifferent memories. You noticed it as well, didn't you? How this world isn't normal.
People were fawning over me and I had been able to give the always-belligerent Gaiza a beating.
It had honestly been a great feeling... but it definitely hadn't been the reality I knew.
It's a Ninja Art of a woman called the "Phantom Witch."
Yes. A Taimanin who is called a "Witch"ー
I'll spare you the details since it doesn't directly relate to the current situation and it would take a while.
A Taimanin opposed us and used her Ninja Art...?
That fact bothered me a little, but for now I decided to continue listening to what she had to say.
As you noticed, this world is not the world we know.
Her Ninja Art reflects the desires and fantasies of the target, creating an illusionary world so to speakー
Which means, this world is the realization of your desires and fantasies.
The realization of my desires and fantasies...? What are you talking abo-...
And just when I was about to ask for more details...
Ahh, Fuma!! That's where you were!!
What are you doing, skipping class in place like this!? I came looking for you since I heard you left during class!!
It was my classmate and my arch enemy, Mizuki Yukikaze.
N-No, I just... I just had something to take care of...
I ended up stumbling over my words at her unexpected appearance.
Huh? Something to take care of?
(This is bad... It's gonna get tricky if she tattles on me to the teachers.)
While I was mulling that over, Yukikaze turned her fierce gaze upon Asuka and stared at her.
And who is this? Someone from another school? Why are you two sneaking around here?
Yes. Who are you? Why is someone from a different school here?
You weren't gonna do anything strange with him, were you?
Since she wasn't a student at Gosha Academy, I suppose it should have been obvious, but the uniform Asuka was wearing was one I had never seen before, belonging to a different school.
No, ummm... I'm a... transfer student?
Y-Yes! I got a bit lost... so I was asking him where the staffroom is... ehehe.
This could also be wrangled into an excuse for why I had left in the middle of class.
Hmmm, so that's what it was...?
Yukikaze nodded like she understood, but glared at Asuka with a slightly suspicious look.
(However... Hey, Asuka, is this really also an illusion...!?)
I whispered to Asuka standing next to me.
(Her face, her voice, no matter how you look at her, she's the real Mizuki Yukikaze...)
(It's an illusion. She looks real to you because your mind is projecting her exactly how you remember her.)
(Well, her faults will show soon, just wait and see.)
(No matter how sophisticated it is, it's still just a reproduction born from your fantasiesー)
(Yes. What you wish for or want to do naturally shows up in their behavior.)
As we whispered, Yukikaze's expression suddenly changed.
In that case it's fine!! More importantly... Hey, Fuma? You didn't forget what you promised me, did you...?
She looked like a maiden in love.
It was strangely disturbing to see how she instantly changed from her standoffish attitude to even showing a bashful smile.
Yes♪ You promised we'd study together after school today, remember?
You did~ I said I'm having trouble with preparing for the finals and you said you'd help me since you're so smart...
Heh... hehe...? I said something like that...?
Unfortunately, I had absolutely no such memory.
Of course I'll show my appreciation. After studying, we will do this and that... just the two of us, like we always do... hehe♪
Th-This and that...!? What do you...?
Oh, you silly goose. I can't say that in front of others now, can I?♪
Yukikaze didn't say it clearly, but she definitely implied something sexy.
(You... what are you making the illusions do...?)
I hurriedly shook my head at Asuka, who was giving me a disturbed look.
Were there illusions that I could remember and illusions that I couldn't remember?
Anyway, I had absolutely no memory of doing this and that after studying with Yukikaze.
However, that wasn't the end of it.
Hold it right there, Yukikaze!! Fuma-kun already promised me today!!
Standing there was Akiyama Rinko, who was popular within the school because of her even-handed personality and exceptional beauty.
What is it, Rinko? Do you have something to complain about?
Rinko had appeared suddenly and Yukikaze blocked her path, looking ready to throw down.
She appeared virtuous and elegant as always, but what she was saying was somewhat strange.
Fuma-kun has plans to practice swordsmanship with me after school today.
And now you come in after the fact... Really, could you please stop trying to steal him from me?
The two were exchanging stern glances.
(You do stuff with this girl in your fantasies as well?)
(Nonononono!!! I don't know!! I don't know!!)
It was too painful watching Asuka's gaze getting colder and colder.
Anyway, I vigorously shook my head in denial.
Wrong!! The one who is the thief is you, Rinko-chan!!
That's right!! He's supposed to do student council work with us after school!!
Two voices suddenly rang out from behind us.
Hmhmmm♪ It's the ever-intimate Sakura-sensei andー
Murasaki. As the student council advisor, I can't hand him over to you.
Igawa Sakura-sensei and Yatsu Murasaki-senseiーThey were both beautiful teachers who were phenomenally popular amongst the students.
Wh-What!? I don't understand why you teachers are here all of a sudden!!
Yukikaze was the first to jump down the throats of the sudden intruders.
R-Right!! His plans are settled!?ーThis is unbelievable!!
Just deciding my little brother's plans on your own, that's unbecoming of a teacher!!
Wait, Rinko-chan. He's not your brother, you know.
Sakura-sensei incisively shot back at Rinko-senpai's mysterious remark.
Anyway, Fuma-kun has to go with us for student council work.ーRight, Murasaki?
Indeed. I'm sorry, you two, but this is a sacred duty that benefits the whole academy. It's absolutely not something that can be neglected for personal reasons.
Murasaki-sensei said in an attempt to make them understand.
Her tone was calm and what she said made sense.
It was enough to silence even Yukikaze and Rinko-senpai, as they had nothing to say in return.
Hey, Murasaki? Who's going to do today's "adult lesson" first?
There's a fetish that I want to teach Fuma-kun about~♪
N-Nitwit!! Don't say that now, Sakura!!
What do you mean by "adult lesson!?" Murasaki-sensei, are you teaching him something naughty!?
Now Murasaki-sensei was faltering under their verbal counterattack.
It's nothing particularly naughty. And Fuma-kun likes it♪
What... depravity!! I can't leave him with you perverted teachers. I'm definitely taking my little brother with me!
Four beautiful women were having an intense dispute over meー
Asuka's gaze, of course, was colder than cold.
(Haah... Why don't you just go with them? I've lost any interest in helping you.)
(I told you, I don't know anything about thiiiiiiiiiiiiis!!)
I became more and more confused due to the sheer ridiculousness of the situation.
There was the earth-shaking sound of footsteps coming from down the hallway.
The rumbling footsteps were coming from an all-female crowd of Gosha Academy students.
And they were all screaming "Fuma-senpai!!" or "Master!!" in shrill voices.
You know them, right? They're the "Fuma-kun Groupies."
Uh~oh, it's a tough opponent, huh~
Yeah. They're crazy girls that are so in love with Fuma-kun that they would even sacrifice their lives for him. We can't let our guards down...
Sakura-sensei and Murasaki-sensei nodded at each other with grim faces.
What the hell!? What the heeeeeell?
I was panicking because I was so confused.
Ah~ I can't deal with this anymore!! We can't even talk with these people around!! Let's get out of here!!
Asuka grabbed my hand and tried to escape in the opposite direction from the "groupies."
However, the girls didn't fail to notice.
Wait, you!! Where do you think you're going!?
The mad screams of the girls mixed with the sound of countless footsteps.
I didn't know what was going on, but I was sure I wouldn't get out easily if they caught me.
Driven by a primal fear, I ran away from the girls as fast as I could.
